'''Irek''' was the young [[Human/Legends|Human]] nephew of the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Bant'ena Fhernan]], and the older brother ofto [[Tam (baby)|Tam]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]] showed a hologram of the two children playing in the park and warned Bant'ena that if she refused to help the Separatists, he would [[Death/Legends|kill]] them.
